core_obligations: The author builds one non-adaptive parity-query set simultaneously controlling all residual restrictions, couples Fourier support merging to uncertainty and affine monochromatic restrictions, and sums the support-decrease charges to obtain the square-root times logarithmic dimension bound. The complete algorithm, local support lemmas and improved analysis credited to Avishay Tal are retained.
